# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.gaps import gap_labels


class GapLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.opening = parse_span("09:00-17:00")

    def test_empty_day_is_one_gap(self):
        """With nobody working, all of opening hours is one gap."""
        labels = gap_labels([], self.opening)
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_lunch_gap(self):
        """A break between two shifts becomes one labelled gap."""
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-12:00"), parse_span("13:00-17:00")]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, self.opening)
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        """Time uncovered before and after a shift gets a label each."""
        worked = [parse_span("10:00-16:00")]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, self.opening)
        self.assertEqual(
            labels,
            ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 16:00-17:00 (60 min)"],
        )

    def test_fully_covered_has_no_gaps(self):
        """A worked span across all of opening hours leaves no gaps."""
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-17:00")]
        self.assertEqual(gap_labels(worked, self.opening), [])

    def test_overlapping_and_touching_spans_close_gaps(self):
        """Overlapping and touching worked spans count as one cover."""
        worked = [
            parse_span("09:00-12:00"),
            parse_span("11:00-13:00"),
            parse_span("13:00-17:00"),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(gap_labels(worked, self.opening), [])

    def test_span_starting_before_opening_raises(self):
        """A worked span starting before opening hours is an error."""
        worked = [parse_span("08:30-10:00")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            gap_labels(worked, self.opening)

    def test_span_ending_after_closing_raises(self):
        """A worked span ending after closing is an error."""
        worked = [parse_span("16:00-17:30")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            gap_labels(worked, self.opening)
